contentChooseUploadFolder: Choose an image upload folder first. The original image and content draft are retained.
contentDraftHelp: Drafts stay in the current memory. Background refresh and language changes keep drafts; reloading discards changes in the current content language. Removing a reference does not delete library files.
contentEmpty: No rich text content in this language.
contentInvalidDocument: Invalid content structure. File nodes must contain file and version identities.
contentLocaleHelp: Each content language is saved independently. Switching languages keeps each draft in memory.
contentReferenceChanged: This content node changed. Select the reference to replace again.
contentReload: Discard this language draft and reload
contentSavedRefreshFailed: Content and references were saved, but refresh failed. Check the saved content before saving again.
contentSaveUnconfirmed: The save result is unconfirmed. Your draft is retained; check the server content first.
contentUploadHelp: Choose an upload folder in this organization, then upload images from the toolbar, paste or drag and drop. Completed uploads insert a fixed file version.
contentUploadsPending: Image uploads are still in progress. Save content after they finish or you explicitly cancel them.
contentVersionHelp: Only explicitly saving this choice changes the content reference. Overwriting the library file does not change it automatically.
createDescription: Create a draft project and save its content.
deleteDescription: Delete {{name}} and all of its translations. This cannot be undone.
editDescription: Select a content language, then edit its name, description, and status.
emptyDescription: Create the first project and it will appear here.
name: Project name
notFoundDescription: This project does not exist or does not belong to the current organization.
title: Projects
translationLoadFailed: The selected content language could not be loaded.
